text:
Alex: Quick thread — I ran the traffic mixer against the kv-cache-heavy profile and we got a clear perf regression. TL;DR: long-tail spikes + our batching heuristics are causing KV entries to be evicted before reuse, which spikes p99 for microbursts.

Maria: Which run? config?

Alex: run-id: run-2167-prod-sim. attaching the generator config we used (excerpt):
```yaml
generator:
  seed: 42
  qps_profile: staggered_ramp
  bursts:
    - peak_qps: 320
      duration_ms: 200
    - peak_qps: 150
      duration_ms: 400
  tail_shape: pareto(1.5)
  kv_warmup: true
  kv_eviction_seconds: 120
  pin_fraction: 0.02
```

Cheng: Two quick notes: (1) kernel selection for short sequences can flip to the "fused" attention path which increases memory churn if batches are large, (2) our batching heuristic currently ramps batch_size aggressively when qps spikes detect — that interacts badly with KV locality.

Sam: I saw the dashboard — p99 jumped from ~120ms to ~320ms at the burst apex. link: https://redwood.internal/perf/dash?run=2167 (screenshot in thread)

Maria: We should split the synthetic workload into phases: warmup (steady low qps), burst (short high qps), and lull (very low qps) to let kv cache behavior surface. Also try a config where we pin a small set of keys so reuse probability increases during bursts.

Alex: Proposed experiment matrix: baseline (current generator), kv-pinned (pin_fraction: 0.05), batch-cap-32 (force max batch size 32), and kv-eviction-extended (eviction_seconds: 600). Measure: p50/p95/p99, kv hit-rate, kernel-switch events, and memory churn.

perf-bot: Perfbot: Regression detected on run-2167 — p99 +2.6x vs baseline. Trace sample ids: trace-2167-01, trace-2167-07.

Cheng: Also enable kernel selection tracing in harness so we can correlate kernel branch counts with latency spikes. We need counters for: attempted_fused, fallback_standard, kernel_switch_latency_ns.

Sam: I'll kick off three runs in the harness: baseline, kv-pinned, batch-cap-32. ETA ~2h. Using this command: 
```bash
./traffic-harness \
  --profile run-2167 \
  --emit-kernel-events \
  --kv-hist-interval 10s \
  --qps-profile configs/staggered_ramp.yaml \
  --output-prefix /tmp/run-2167
```

Maria: Also add kv occupancy histogram logging and a tiny script to compute reuse windows from trace: `scripts/kv_reuse_agg.py --trace-dir /tmp/run-2167/traces --window 500ms`.

Alex: Cool. If kv-pinned improves p99, we should consider adding an optional pin-set for microburst routes in the runtime or at least surface a recommendation in Optimize.

Cheng: If batch-cap-32 helps, it suggests our batch-growth heuristic should be throttled when kv hit-rate drops below threshold. Add a metric and an SLO guard.

Sam: Starting baseline now, will paste results + flamegraphs when done.

Alex: Thanks — please @Maria @Cheng when you post results so we can triage kernel vs kv cause. :thumbsup:
